defs.def: a work of art that is a solid figure or object made by carving or shaping wood, stone, clay, metal, etc. 雕像；雕塑品；雕刻品

ex.s: Beautiful year-round, they invite you to enjoy the smallest detail, from the sound of grasses in the gentle wind to the sculpture of odd-looking seed heads.
ex.t: 一年四季都美丽，它们邀你欣赏最细微的细节，从微风中草叶的声音到奇特种穗的造型。
一幅美丽的画作或雕塑。

ex.s: Made of 168,000 plastic straws collected from several volunteer beach cleanups, the sculpture made its first appearance at the Estella Place shopping center in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam.
ex.t: 由从几次志愿者海滩清理中收集的168,000根塑料吸管制成，这座雕塑首次亮相于越南胡志明市的Estella Place购物中心。

ex.s: How could I possibly take the time to pose for a sculpture now?
ex.t: 我现在怎么可能抽时间来当雕塑模特？

ex.s: For example, in our free time we can sculpt a sculpture and paint a painting, but we take a photo.
ex.t: 例如,在我们的自由时间里,我们可以雕塑和绘画,但我们可以拍照。

ex.s: That huge sculpture you can see is the Winged Victory of Samothrace, or Nike of Samothrace!
ex.t: 你可以看到那巨大的雕塑 是萨摩太的胜利之翼 或萨摩太的耐克!

ex.s: More recently, as books have become inexpensive or even throwaway, artists have used them as the raw material for artworks — transforming covers, pages or even complete volumes into paintings and sculptures.
ex.t: 近来，随着书籍变得廉价甚至一次性，艺术家把它们当作艺术品的原材料——将封面、书页甚至整本书变成绘画和雕塑。

ex.s: Similar research has been done to understand the “neuronal fireworks” that occur when we look at inspiring sculptures, attractive faces, impressive dance, etc
ex.t: 类似的研究已用来理解我们看鼓舞人心的雕塑、迷人的脸、动人的舞蹈等时发生的“神经元烟花”。

ex.s: With a 3D printer， a cook can print complicated chocolate sculptures and beautiful pieces for decoration on a wedding cake． Not everybody can do that﹣it takes years of experience， but a printer makes it easy． A restaurant  in Spain uses a Foodini to "re﹣create forms and pieces" of food that are "exactly the same，" freeing cooks to complete other tasks． In another restaurant， all of the dishes and desserts it serves are 3D﹣printed， rather than farm to table．
ex.t: 有了3D打印机，厨师能打印复杂的巧克力雕塑和婚礼蛋糕上漂亮的装饰件。不是人人都能做到——那需要多年经验，但打印机让它变得简单。西班牙一家餐厅用Foodini“重现”食物的“形状和部件”，做到“完全一致”，解放厨师去完成其他任务。另一家餐厅所有菜肴甜点都是3D打印的，而非从农场到餐桌。

ex.s: These objects have given him ideas for his animal sculptures, such as the famous Rubber Duck.
ex.t: 这些物品为他的动物雕塑,如著名的橡皮鸭,给了他一些想法.

defs.def: the art of making sculptures 雕刻术；雕塑术

ex.s: He builds massive sculptures out of plastic garbage, foreing viewers to re-examine their relationship to single-use plastic products.
ex.t: 他用塑料垃圾建造大型雕塑,让观众重新审视他们与单用途塑料制品的关系.

ex.s: These sculptures were painted a rainbow of striking colours.
ex.t: 这些雕塑被涂上了彩虹般醒目的色彩。
